name: Circa Enterprises Inc.
summary: Circa Enterprises Inc. manufactures and supplies telecommunications and electrical products in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Telecommunications (Telecom) and Metal Fabrication (Metals). The Telecom segment offers surge protection products, ruggedized high-performance telecommunications equipment, and computer cables and related connectivity products under the CircaMax brand. The Metals segment provides enclosures, pole line hardware, and other products to the Canadian electrical industry under the Hydel brand. The company also designs, builds, and commissions PA/GA, page/talk, telephone, and talk/back paging systems; provides sheet metal fabrication services; and offers design and engineering/prototyping, fiber laser cutting, CNC brake press forming, and custom finishing services. Circa Enterprises Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
